clips.title: The story
paras: At Alexston Farmstead, wild Harvest Watchers prowl the ruined fields. Baros Alexston grew up here before becoming Stormwind's city architect.

Alexston Farmstead lies amid Westfall's dry plains, abandoned like the neighboring estates. Its caretakers fled when banditry spread across the countryside. Now the fields have grown wild, and the Harvest Watchers left to tend the crops attack anyone who comes near the barren farmhouse.

Baros Alexston spent his youth working these fields before leaving to pursue masonry and construction. He became one of Stormwind's most prominent citizens, helping design parts of the rebuilt capital. Something from his early life remains among the ruins.
